UPDATE ethereum_111k_control SET paused = 0, revision = revision + 1,
    paused_at_ms = NULL,
    chain_id = 11155111, contract_address = '0xab705be519d707a56f43abd63f0869e88fc882b7', updated_at_ms = (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000)
    WHERE singleton = 1 AND revision = 21 AND reset_guard_id IS NULL
      AND paused = 1
      AND chain_id IS 11155111 AND contract_address IS '0xc7571e9dc4b1cd646d092d51cfa89a76a6461fec'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commerce_documents WHERE drop_id = '111k_devnet')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ethereum_delivery_quotes WHERE chain_id = 11155111 AND contract_address = '0xc7571e9dc4b1cd646d092d51cfa89a76a6461fec')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ethereum_delivery_checkouts WHERE chain_id = 11155111 AND contract_address = '0xc7571e9dc4b1cd646d092d51cfa89a76a6461fec')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ethereum_crate_claims WHERE chain_id = 11155111 AND contract_address = '0xc7571e9dc4b1cd646d092d51cfa89a76a6461fec')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ethereum_reconciliation_cursor WHERE chain_id = 11155111 AND contract_address = '0xc7571e9dc4b1cd646d092d51cfa89a76a6461fec') RETURNING *
